rubric.statement: The program wraps the prefixed signature definition in warning capture and verifies a deprecation warning saying the `prefix` argument has no effect in DSPy.
The program inspects the signature fields and asserts that the custom input and output prefixes are still stored in each field's `json_schema_extra["prefix"]`.
The proof renders both the system-side structure and the user-side content through `dspy.ChatAdapter`, so it checks the actual default chat prompt instead of only inspecting metadata.

The program asserts that neither custom prefix string appears in the rendered system message or user message, consistent with chat rendering that uses field-name markers and output reminders rather than the stored `prefix` metadata.
